narrative.overview:
The site reads like a clean map with annotations laid over it. The content is the terrain: plain, readable, generously spaced on light paper. On top of it sit the annotations: monospaced uppercase labels, small accent squares as markers, thin hairline rings, a survey reticle around the portrait, and faint topographic contours in the dark bands. The annotations orient the visitor; they never compete with the content.

Two dark bands in the main color bracket the page: the hero at the top and the contact band at the bottom, with the header pinned in the same color. Everything between alternates paper and white. The single accent color is the signal: actions, the current state, and the markers that make the map legible. Components are precise and confident: crisp radii, solid accent fills, tight labels.

The whole palette comes from two inputs, main and accent, and every text color is solved for WCAG contrast against its background, so the system holds for any pair.
keyCharacteristics: Two input colors; every other shade derived and contrast-solved.
Expanded-width Archivo headings over plain Archivo body text, with JetBrains Mono as the annotation voice.
Flat surfaces with hairline rings; depth appears only on interaction and for floating layers.
Map motifs (contours, grid, reticle, square markers) used as line art, never as fills.

rules.name: The Two-Input Rule
rules.body: Only `main` and `accent` are chosen. Every other color is derived by `npm run tokens` and never edited by hand.

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: The accent marks action, current state and markers. It is never a background for large areas or a decoration for its own sake.

rules.name: The Small-Text Rule
rules.body: Small orange text always uses `accent-ink` on light surfaces and `accent-glow` on main, never the raw `accent`.

rules.name: The Map Legend Rule
rules.body: Uppercase mono with wide tracking is for labels, dates and metadata only. Sentences are never set in it.

rules.name: The Lift-On-Intent Rule
rules.body: Nothing casts a shadow at rest except floating layers. Shadows answer interaction or mark something that floats above the page.

rules.name: The Square Marker Rule
rules.body: List bullets and eyebrow markers are small accent squares. Round dots are reserved for status (the current-role indicator).

dos: **Do** change the palette by editing `colors.main` and `colors.accent` in this file and running `npm run tokens`.
**Do** style with the theme tokens (`bg-main`, `text-on-main-muted`, `text-accent-ink`, and so on) so every color follows the theme.
**Do** keep orange small text on `accent-ink` or `accent-glow` (The Small-Text Rule).
**Do** use Radix icons for every icon.
**Do** respect reduced motion: reveals, the pulsing status dot and the reticle rotation all switch off.
donts: **Don't** hard-code hex values or Tailwind palette colors (`text-white`, `neutral-*`) in components. The exceptions are white card surfaces, black-alpha hairlines and shadows, and the status colors in the contrast grades.
**Don't** use thick colored side stripes on cards or toasts as an accent.
**Don't** set sentences in the uppercase mono label style (The Map Legend Rule).
**Don't** add shadows to surfaces at rest (The Lift-On-Intent Rule).
